sessions.abstract:
In this instructor-led training, an AWS expert will guide participants through the core concepts of generative AI and machine learning — including foundation models, large language models, and the fundamentals of training a model with Amazon SageMaker. Participants will then learn how to build AI applications on Amazon Bedrock, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground responses in relevant data and guardrails to keep those applications safe and reliable.
The instructor will walk througg a real-world use case showing how generative AI can drive business value for customer experience using Amazon Bedrock.

It reaches across all your company's data – documents, databases, emails, Slack threads, dashboards, Jira tickets – and lets you search it, ask questions, and take action, all from one place. Available across web, mobile, Slack, and Microsoft tools with multi-model intelligence, Quick delivers consumer-grade AI with enterprise-grade security and governance. No vendor lock-in, no siloed copilots. Just one AI teammate that works wherever you do.

Learn how Getir used a custom context layer and internal documentation via MCP to turn generic responses into architecture-aware analysis, cutting mean time to resolution.

sessions.abstract: The Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC), operator of KhalifaSat, captures terabytes of Earth-observation imagery — but turning data into insights has required weeks of specialist effort. In this session, see how AWS and MBRSC built a geospatial AI agent on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Users draw a polygon, ask a question in plain language, and the agent writes and executes Python code — fetching satellite imagery, running vegetation, thermal, and burn-severity analyses, and returning map overlays in under a minute. We cover the coding-agent architecture, open-vocabulary object detection on Amazon SageMaker, and decisions behind production-ready agentic AI.

sessions.abstract: An agent is a model plus a harness: the foundation that runs tools, manages memory, enforces guardrails, and provides observability. Most agentic AI stalls between proof-of-concept and production because teams build the model and improvise the rest. This session shows how to build that foundation on AWS for scaling agentic apps. Foodics, the restaurant platform behind 50,000+ F&B businesses across MENA, worked with the AWS GenAI Innovation Center to rebuild merchant onboarding as an agent, cutting menu digitization from 14 days to minutes. You'll leave with the reference architecture, the things that broke, and what we'd do differently.

sessions.abstract: The AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) represents a transformative approach to software engineering that positions AI as a central collaborator throughout the development process. Unlike traditional AI-assisted development methods, AI-DLC reimagines the entire software lifecycle through two key dimensions: AI-powered execution with human oversight and dynamic team collaboration. The methodology operates in three phases - Inception, Construction, and Operations - where AI initiates workflows while maintaining persistent context across all stages. This innovative approach delivers significant benefits including increased velocity, enhanced quality, improved market responsiveness, and better developer experience, all while ensuring critical human oversight and collaboration.

We'll share practical architectures, engineering decisions, and strategies for selecting the right compute infrastructure — from training to serving — while managing costs effectively across one of the region's most data-intensive technology organizations.

sessions.abstract: As generative AI adoption accelerates, architects face a critical question: should they rely on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground LLM responses or embrace the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for richer tool integration and orchestration? This session provides a practical decision framework for selecting the right approach, or combining both for your enterprise workloads. We will dive deep into RAG architectures on AWS, and explore MCP concepts for enabling secure, structured interactions between models and external tools. Through real-world patterns and live demos, you’ll learn when RAG alone is sufficient, when MCP offers a better fit, and how to design hybrid.

In this session, hear how they built Wadi — a fully serverless analytics platform using Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena — achieving over 99% cost reduction while gaining complete control of their data. Learn the cost-engineering patterns (columnar storage, partition pruning, pre-aggregated rollups) and discover how Amazon Bedrock adds AI-powered insights. Walk away with a repeatable blueprint for building your own serverless analytics stack.

Through an interactive demo, you'll see how to get started with Lambda durable functions in your IDE, and use primitives like “steps” and “waits” for state management, failure handling, and seamless execution of long-running business logic. When anomalies are detected, alerts trigger an AWS DevOps agent that autonomously queries metrics through a Prometheus MCP server and follows structured runbooks to investigate. Using a 5G network monitoring scenario, we show how this pattern reduces mean time to resolution. Attendees leave with a deployable open-source reference architecture from AWS Samples.

Learn how RAKBANK designed a multi-tier logging architecture using Amazon OpenSearch with hot and ultrawarm storage tiers, FluentBit for log routing, and S3 for long-term archival. We cover architecture decisions from OpenTelemetry collection, Grafana integration, OpenSearch Anomaly Detection and AI-powered PPL queries for proactive incident response. This approach cut observability costs by over 50% compared to a single-tier alternative, while maintaining 60-day queryable retention and 7-year compliance archival—all production-ready in under 4 weeks.

sessions.abstract: Embark on a faster, smoother cloud transformation with agentic AI and integrated solutions. This session reveals how AWS Transform accelerates your cloud journey, addressing migration and modernization challenges through intelligent automation. Through real-world examples, discover how to leverage this powerful integration to fast-track your cloud adoption and transformation efforts. With the specialized AI agents of AWS Transform, customers can migrate VMware workloads to Amazon EC2, modernize .NET applications to cross-platform .NET, and modernize IBM z/OS mainframe applications, delivering transformation projects up to 4x faster.

sessions.abstract: Join us for an engaging session on AI Agents and Tools in AWS, where we’ll explore how to build intelligent, autonomous systems using Amazon Bedrock and open-source frameworks. Learn about function calling, ReAct patterns, and AWS’s comprehensive agent platforms. We’ll dive into practical demonstrations using Strands and CrewAI, and discover how to leverage protocols like MCP and A2A for seamless tool integration and agent collaboration. Perfect for developers looking to create production-ready AI solutions.

sessions.abstract: This session demonstrates how Kiro brings discipline and clarity to AI-assisted software development, ensuring generated code aligns with intended functionality and architecture. Explore Kiro's innovative spec-driven development approach for AI coding. Learn how to leverage structured specifications as a single source of truth, contrasting with unstructured 'vibe coding'. Discover how Kiro uses AI to generate detailed requirements, design, and task documents, guiding AI agents in code creation. Experience a workflow that enhances collaboration, maintainability, and documentation accuracy.
